top_signals.title: Viral AI actress' hotline face-scans every caller, watches their mood
top_signals.summary: AI actress Tilly Norwood went viral after glitching into Chinese on Piers Morgan Uncensored last night. Her "Talking Tilly" video call service face-scans every caller for an 18+ age check, senses callers' moods during calls, and shuts down permanently on September 27. We tried it and read the fine print. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
